correctness.rationale: The exact point–line incidence rule has 14 vertices, 21 edges and no graph-model ambiguity. Exhaustive enumeration of all 16,384 subsets leaves 2,256 nonempty faces with f-vector (14,91,322,651,728,392,58). Deterministic sequential pivot matching has 1,121 distinct facet pairs and precisely one critical vertex and thirteen critical five-simplices. Every one of the 10,150 cover incidences is checked and the reversed matched Hasse graph admits a complete 2,256-node topological order; Forman discrete Morse therefore proves the full integral wedge of thirteen five-spheres without assuming that field homology determines homotopy. Separate mod-two simplicial boundary elimination agrees. For the automorphism representation, all 168 invertible binary three-dimensional general linear group matrices and all 168 incidence-swapping elements are independently verified as graph permutations; every signed Lefschetz trace is computed both from permutation-orbit parity and by oriented-simplex inversion parity. The character identity on binary three-dimensional general linear group equals 1 + twice the seven-point augmentation character; the 168 duality-coset traces are all -1. By 2-transitivity and character averaging, the one-dimensional GL-invariant subspace is duality-odd, hence there are no full-automorphism invariants. The supplied complete verifier was executed successfully.

originality.rationale: This is the 2-independence (induced maximum degree one) simplicial complex of the 14-vertex Heawood graph, not its ordinary independence complex or the edge-based two-matching complex. The same-parameter Petersen theorem is graph-specific and gives no universal cubic-graph implication. Direct complete text comparison to these indexed publications and primary higher-independence papers does not supply this exact thirteen-sphere theorem or the 336-element equivariant character. Literature absence is not logically proved, and possible differently indexed equivalents remain a risk.
residual_risks: Semantic and keyword searches do not prove global novelty; a differently indexed or unindexed Heawood 2-independence calculation could exist.
No new all-incidence-graph family theorem is supplied; this result concerns only the exact fourteen-vertex Fano plane incidence graph.
A separate independent scientific audit is not performed.

value.rationale: This computes a natural first higher-independence invariant on the canonical smallest cubic girth-six graph, one not in the explicit high-independence homotopy families. The nonpure 70-facet/five-dimensional plus 58-facet/six-dimensional complex has unexpectedly pure five-dimensional integral homotopy, and the complete 336-element character provides additional structural information: a line invariant under all Fano collineations reverses under dualities. Ordinary independence Betti numbers, matching complexes and numerical k-independence bounds do not contain these facts. This complete, nonroutine finite case is motivated as an equivariant benchmark for higher independence rather than an arbitrary slice or an unsubstantiated broad generalization.
